description: Datestamped, checksummed snapshots archived to the permaweb (Arweave via Permavault) for reproducibility and resilience. Public-domain or clearly-redistributable data only, since permaweb copies are public and permanent. Each entry lets any past Allelio result be reproduced against the exact reference data it used.

snapshots.note: Legacy format-1 extract preserved for reproducibility; superseded by format 2.
variant_summary.txt.gz. Weekly rolling release; this is an insurance/reproducibility snapshot, NOT loaded by the tool (which fetches ClinVar live).

bitcoin_anchor_notice.verification_method: Verified the Ed25519 signature over manifest.json, matched its SHA-256 and signing-key fingerprint, confirmed the manifest binds the released gzip artifact's SHA-256, matched manifest.ots to its Arweave copy, evaluated its OpenTimestamps path, and matched the resulting Merkle root to Bitcoin block 966805's public header.
bitcoin_anchor_notice.note: The timestamp proof binds the signed manifest, which names the exact compressed .tsv.gz artifact and SHA-256 recorded by this snapshot.

snapshots.note: Allele-aware consumer-array frequency extract; source provenance in data/gnomad_manifest.json.
